ValidationRule.description: The order form normalises what the buyer types down to letters, digits, hyphen and underscore before looking it up, so a code stored with a space, an apostrophe or a stray character can never be matched. Saving one produces a code that is impossible to redeem and gives no clue why, so it is refused at entry.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Code may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores (no spaces or punctuation), and must be 40 characters or fewer.
